notes: Access: pbteen.com is Akamai-WAF-protected. Direct HTTP (curl_cffi, chrome120 impersonation) worked for the homepage (200) and sitemap XML files but returned 403 'Restricted Access' on every /shop/ path. Playwright headless (bundled Chromium and real installed Chrome channel) was blocked outright by Akamai even on the homepage; Playwright headed (headless=False, real Chrome channel) reached the homepage and several /shop/ PLPs successfully before also hitting a 403 on /shop/sale/. Escalated to Claude-in-Chrome (mcp) for the rest, per the access-tier rules; robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow. Navigation discovery: homepage header nav links (Best Sellers / New / Sale), the site's own shop-sitemap-index.xml (fetched directly, 611 URLs), and the nav pills shown on each Best Sellers PLP itself (Dorm, Furniture, Bedding, Lighting, Study, Decor, Backpacks & Luggage, Lounge, Rugs, Window, Bath, Storage, Gifting) which are genuine site-exposed department sub-listings of the same 'Best Sellers' concept, each with its own 'View N Items' count -- confirmed by opening every one. All facet/filter permutations under /shop/best-sellers/ (color, price, size, etc.) were treated as arbitrary filter pages and excluded, not as genuine sub-categories. 'All Best Sellers' (642) is the deduplicated master listing; department rows overlap with it and with each other (sums exceed 642), which is expected per the brief's overlap rule. The 'Furniture Best Sellers' sitemap URL (furniture-best-sellers-1) actually resolves to a facet combining the 'Furniture' department AND a 'Sofas, Sectionals & Futons' producttype chip (page title: 'Furniture Sofas, Sectionals & Futons All Best Sellers') rather than a clean unfiltered Furniture department view -- flagged for manual review since it may be a narrower slice than a plain 'Furniture Best Sellers' page would suggest. 'Gifts Best Sellers' (bestselling-gifts-1) is a separate dedicated Best-Selling Gifts PLP outside the facet system, included since Gifting appears as its own tab on every other Best Sellers PLP's nav pills.
